import pytest
from semverrange import satisfies


# Version Parsing and Validation Tests

class TestVersionParsing:
    """Test valid version formats."""
    
    def test_basic_version(self):
        """Basic MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH versions are valid."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
    
    def test_version_with_leading_v(self):
        """Leading 'v' is allowed."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
    
    def test_version_with_prerelease(self):
        """Versions with prerelease tags are valid."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.1", "1.2.3-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-0", "1.2.3-0")
    
    def test_version_with_build_metadata(self):
        """Versions with build metadata are valid."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+20130313144700", "1.2.3")
    
    def test_version_with_prerelease_and_build(self):
        """Versions can have both prerelease and build."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha+build", "1.2.3-alpha")
    
    def test_version_with_whitespace(self):
        """Surrounding whitespace is ignored."""
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")


class TestInvalidVersions:
    """Test that invalid versions raise ValueError."""
    
    def test_incomplete_version(self):
        """Incomplete versions like 1.2 are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")
    
    def test_incomplete_version_no_patch(self):
        """Missing patch version is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1", "*")
    
    def test_leading_zeros_in_major(self):
        """Leading zeros in numeric parts are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("01.2.3", "*")
    
    def test_leading_zeros_in_minor(self):
        """Leading zeros in minor are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.02.3", "*")
    
    def test_leading_zeros_in_patch(self):
        """Leading zeros in patch are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.03", "*")
    
    def test_leading_zeros_in_numeric_prerelease(self):
        """Leading zeros in numeric prerelease identifiers are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-01", "*")
    
    def test_empty_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease cannot be empty (1.2.3- is invalid)."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-", "*")
    
    def test_too_many_version_parts(self):
        """1.2.3.4 is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4", "*")
    
    def test_non_numeric_major(self):
        """Non-numeric major version is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("a.b.c", "*")
    
    def test_invalid_prerelease_characters(self):
        """Invalid characters in prerelease are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-alpha@beta", "*")


# Version Comparison Tests

class TestVersionOrdering:
    """Test version comparison rules."""
    
    def test_major_version_ordering(self):
        """Major versions are compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">=2.0.0")
    
    def test_minor_version_ordering(self):
        """Minor versions are compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.1.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.0", ">=1.2.0")
    
    def test_patch_version_ordering(self):
        """Patch versions are compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.3", ">=1.1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.2", ">=1.1.3")
    
    def test_prerelease_lower_than_release(self):
        """A prerelease version is lower than the release."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.0.0")
    
    def test_prerelease_numeric_vs_alphanumeric(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifiers are lower than alphanumeric."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha")
    
    def test_prerelease_fewer_identifiers_lower(self):
        """Fewer prerelease identifiers means lower."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-alpha.1")


# Exact Matching Tests

class TestExactMatching:
    """Test exact version matching (= operator and default)."""
    
    def test_exact_match(self):
        """Exact match works."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
    
    def test_exact_match_with_equals(self):
        """= operator works."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "=1.2.3")
    
    def test_exact_match_with_whitespace(self):
        """= with whitespace works."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "= 1.2.3")
    
    def test_exact_mismatch(self):
        """Non-matching versions don't satisfy exact match."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "1.2.3")
    
    def test_exact_match_with_prerelease(self):
        """Exact match works with prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")


# Primitive Comparator Tests

class TestPrimitiveComparators:
    """Test <, <=, >, >= operators."""
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("version,range_str,expected", [
        ("1.0.0", "<2.0.0", True),
        ("2.0.0", "<2.0.0", False),
        ("3.0.0", "<2.0.0", False),
        ("1.9.9", "< 2.0.0", True),
    ])
    def test_less_than(self, version, range_str, expected):
        """< operator works correctly."""
        assert satisfies(version, range_str) == expected
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("version,range_str,expected", [
        ("1.0.0", "<=2.0.0", True),
        ("2.0.0", "<=2.0.0", True),
        ("3.0.0", "<=2.0.0", False),
    ])
    def test_less_than_or_equal(self, version, range_str, expected):
        """<= operator works correctly."""
        assert satisfies(version, range_str) == expected
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("version,range_str,expected", [
        ("3.0.0", ">2.0.0", True),
        ("2.0.0", ">2.0.0", False),
        ("1.0.0", ">2.0.0", False),
        ("2.0.1", "> 2.0.0", True),
    ])
    def test_greater_than(self, version, range_str, expected):
        """"> operator works correctly."""
        assert satisfies(version, range_str) == expected
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("version,range_str,expected", [
        ("3.0.0", ">=2.0.0", True),
        ("2.0.0", ">=2.0.0", True),
        ("1.0.0", ">=2.0.0", False),
    ])
    def test_greater_than_or_equal(self, version, range_str, expected):
        """'>=' operator works correctly."""
        assert satisfies(version, range_str) == expected


# X-ranges and Partial Versions Tests

class TestXRanges:
    """Test x, X, * in version ranges."""
    
    def test_star_range_matches_any(self):
        """* matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "*")
        assert satisfies("999.999.999", "*")
    
    def test_x_range_matches_any(self):
        """x matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "x")
    
    def test_uppercase_x_range(self):
        """X matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "X")
    
    def test_empty_range(self):
        """Empty range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "")
    
    def test_major_x_range(self):
        """1.x matches >=1.0.0 <2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", "1.x")
    
    def test_major_only(self):
        """1 is the same as 1.x."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1")
    
    def test_major_minor_x_range(self):
        """1.2.x matches >=1.2.0 <1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2.x")
    
    def test_major_minor_range(self):
        """1.2 is the same as 1.2.x."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2")
    
    def test_greater_than_x_range(self):
        """>1 is >=2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1")
    
    def test_greater_than_x_explicit(self):
        """>1.x is >=2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1.x")
    
    def test_greater_than_minor_x(self):
        """>1.2 is >=1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.9", ">1.2")
    
    def test_greater_than_equal_minor(self):
        """>=1.2 is >=1.2.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">=1.2")
    
    def test_less_than_minor(self):
        """<1.2 is <1.2.0-0 (excludes 1.2.0-prerelease)."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
    
    def test_less_than_equal_minor(self):
        """<=1.2 is <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "<=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<=1.2")
    
    def test_less_than_equal_major(self):
        """<=1 is <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "<=1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<=1")
    
    def test_greater_than_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """>* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", ">*")
    
    def test_less_than_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """<* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", "<*")


# Tilde Range Tests

class TestTildeRanges:
    """Test tilde (~) ranges."""
    
    def test_tilde_specific_version(self):
        """~1.2.3 is >=1.2.3 <1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.99", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "~1.2.3")
    
    def test_tilde_minor_range(self):
        """~1.2 is >=1.2.0 <1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2")
    
    def test_tilde_major_range(self):
        """~1 is >=1.0.0 <2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "~1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "~1")
    
    def test_tilde_zero_minor(self):
        """~0.2.3 is >=0.2.3 <0.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("0.2.3", "~0.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.2.9", "~0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.3.0", "~0.2.3")
    
    def test_tilde_with_prerelease(self):
        """~1.2.3-beta.2 is >=1.2.3-beta.2 <1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3-beta.2")

        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.x")

        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0")

        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.x")
    
    def test_caret_major_range(self):

        assert satisfies("0.5.0", "^0.x")

        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "^0")


# Hyphen Range Tests

class TestHyphenRanges:
    """Test hyphen (-) ranges."""
    
    def test_hyphen_exact(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2.3.4 is >=1.2.3 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("2.3.5", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
    
    def test_hyphen_left_partial_right_exact(self):
        """1.2 - 2.3.4 is >=1.2.0 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
    
    def test_hyphen_left_exact_right_partial(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2.3 is >=1.2.3 <2.4.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.3.9", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.4.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
    
    def test_hyphen_left_exact_right_major_only(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2 is >=1.2.3 <3.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert satisfies("2.5.0", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2")


# Union Range Tests

class TestUnionRanges:
    """Test union (||) ranges."""
    
    def test_union_basic(self):
        """Union matches if any comparator set matches."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x || 3.x")
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || 3.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x || 3.x")
    
    def test_union_multiple(self):
        """Union with multiple sets."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.0.x || 2.0.x || 3.0.x")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.0.x || 2.0.x || 3.0.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.1.0", "1.0.x || 2.0.x || 3.0.x")
    
    def test_union_with_comparators(self):
        """Union with different types of comparators."""
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")


# Comparator Set Tests

class TestComparatorSets:
    """Test multiple comparators in a set (AND logic)."""
    
    def test_multiple_comparators_and(self):
        """Multiple comparators are AND'ed together."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
    
    def test_three_way_and(self):
        """Three comparators are AND'ed."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0 !=1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0 !=1.2.3")
    
    def test_tilde_with_explicit_upper_bound(self):
        """Tilde can be combined with explicit bounds."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2.0 <1.2.8")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.8", "~1.2.0 <1.2.8")


# Prerelease Behavior Tests

class TestPrereleaseBehavior:
    """Test prerelease version matching rules."""
    
    def test_prerelease_matches_prerelease_comparator(self):
        """Prerelease version matches if comparator has prerelease with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")
    
    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_different_major_minor_patch(self):
        """Prerelease of different version doesn't match prerelease comparator."""
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")
    
    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_star(self):
        """1.0.0-beta does not match *."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")
    
    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_less_than_release(self):
        """1.0.0-beta does not match <2.0.0 (no prerelease in comparator)."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")
    
    def test_prerelease_matches_explicit_prerelease_comparator(self):
        """Prerelease matches explicit prerelease comparator in set."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", ">=1.2.3-alpha")
    
    def test_prerelease_matches_set_with_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches if any comparator in set has matching prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", ">1.0.0 >=1.2.3-alpha")
    
    def test_prerelease_tilde_range(self):
        """Prerelease version matches tilde range if comparator has prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "~1.2.3-alpha")
    
    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_tilde_without_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease version does not match tilde range without prerelease."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "~1.2.3")
    
    def test_prerelease_x_range_expansion(self):
        """Prerelease does not match x-range expansion."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0-alpha", "1.2")
    
    def test_release_matches_prerelease_range(self):
        """Release version matches if comparator has prerelease with same MMP."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", ">=1.2.3-alpha")


# Build Metadata Tests

class TestBuildMetadata:
    """Test that build metadata is ignored."""
    
    def test_build_ignored_in_matching(self):
        """Build metadata is ignored."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build1", "1.2.3+build2")
    
    def test_build_in_range(self):
        """Build in range spec is ignored."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3+build")


# Invalid Range Tests

class TestInvalidRanges:
    """Test that invalid ranges raise ValueError."""
    
    def test_invalid_operator(self):
        """>> is not a valid operator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", ">>1.2.3")
    
    def test_invalid_version_in_range(self):
        """Invalid version in range raises error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3.4")
    
    def test_invalid_version_in_range_letters(self):
        """Non-numeric versions in range raise error."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "abc")
    
    def test_incomplete_hyphen_range(self):
        """Hyphen without both parts may be invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 -")
    
    def test_hyphen_in_wrong_position(self):
        """Hyphen in wrong context is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "-1.2.3")


# Edge Cases

class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and boundary conditions."""
    
    def test_zero_version(self):
        """0.0.0 is a valid version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
    
    def test_large_version_numbers(self):
        """Large version numbers work."""
        assert satisfies("999.999.999", ">=1.0.0")
    
    def test_long_prerelease(self):
        """Long prerelease identifiers work."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.1.2.3.4.5", "1.2.3-alpha.1.2.3.4.5")
    
    def test_case_sensitive_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease identifiers are case-sensitive."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-Alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")
    
    def test_whitespace_in_comparator(self):
        """Whitespace around operator is allowed."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "> 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=  1.0.0")
    
    def test_no_whitespace_in_operator(self):

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_wildcard(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match * range."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_less_than_release(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match <X where X is release."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_less_than_with_prerelease_bound(self):
        """Test prerelease matching with prerelease in upper bound."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<1.0.0-gamma")

    def test_prerelease_in_x_range_expansion(self):
        """Test prerelease matching with x-range expansion."""
        # 1.x expands to >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0
        # So 1.0.0-alpha should NOT match (prerelease, different base)
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "1.x")

    def test_prerelease_in_tilde_range(self):
        """Test prerelease matching with tilde range."""
        # ~1.2.3-beta.2 expands to >=1.2.3-beta.2 <1.3.0-0
        # 1.2.3-beta.2 matches because it's in the comparator set
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_prerelease_in_caret_range(self):
        """Test prerelease matching with caret range."""
        # ^1.2.3-beta.2 expands to >=1.2.3-beta.2 <2.0.0-0
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_prerelease_does_not_match_greater_than_release(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match >X where X is release."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">=1.0.0")

class TestInvalidRanges:
    """Tests for invalid range formats."""

    def test_invalid_operator(self):
        """Test that invalid operators raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", ">>1.2.3")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "<<1.2.3")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "===1.2.3")

    def test_invalid_range_version_format(self):
        """Test that invalid version in range raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", ">1.2")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", ">a.b.c")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", ">1.2.3.4")

    def test_invalid_range_gibberish(self):
        """Test that gibberish range raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "abc")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3.4")

    def test_invalid_hyphen_range_no_spaces(self):
        """Test that hyphen ranges require spaces."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2.3-2.3.4")

    def test_invalid_x_range_with_comparison(self):
        """Test that >* and <* match nothing but are valid."""
        # These are valid but match nothing
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("999.999.999", "<*")

class TestEdgeCases:

        """Test with large version numbers."""
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "100.200.300")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", ">99.999.999")
        assert not satisfies("100.200.300", ">100.200.300")

    def test_complex_prerelease(self):
        """Test with complex prerelease identifiers."""
        version = "1.0.0-x.7.z.92"
        assert satisfies(version, version)

    def test_whitespace_in_range_between_comparators(self):
        """Test that whitespace between comparators is handled."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0  <=2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0   <=2.0.0")

    def test_case_insensitive_v_prefix(self):
        """Test that v prefix handling works consistently."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "v1.2.3")

    def test_all_prerelease_identifier_types(self):
        """Test prerelease with all allowed characters."""
        version = "1.0.0-alpha.1.test-123"
        assert satisfies(version, version)

    def test_build_metadata_ignored_in_ranges(self):
        """Test that build metadata doesn't affect range matching."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build1", "1.2.3+build2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+abc", "^1.2.0+xyz")

    def test_very_long_prerelease(self):
        """Test with very long prerelease identifiers."""
        version = "1.0.0-" + ".".join(str(i) for i in range(50))
        assert satisfies(version, version)

    def test_mixed_operators_and_ranges(self):
        """Test mixing different range styles in union."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "~1.2.0 || ^2.0.0 || >=3.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.5.0", "~1.2.0 || ^2.0.0 || >=3.0.0")
        assert satisfies("3.5.0", "~1.2.0 || ^2.0.0 || >=3.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_zero_in_expansion(self):

        assert satisfies("1.2.9", "<1.3.0-0")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0-alpha", "<1.3.0-0")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<1.3.0-0")
